explanation_full: Observations from the Decision Tree (DT) scatter plot diagnostics show that the model achieved an R2 score of 0.5605, indicating a moderate level of variance explained. The Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.1086, and the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) was 0.1755. The correlation between predicted and actual values was 0.787161, suggesting a strong positive linear trend. This suggests that while the model captures a significant portion of the relationship, there is considerable residual error, particularly visible in the maximum absolute residual of 0.597936.
